comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only. Specific-key events (e.g. 'road.enter.Milford Road') are checked before the generic fallback ('road.enter') — add per-road and per-landmark lines here without touching any TypeScript.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Yuh reach Jamaica! Drive on di LEFT — Jamaicans always drive on di LEFT!
Airport to Ochi — one route, pure adventure. Gwaan!
Norman Manley International, straight ahead! Drive careful, drive smart!
Irie! Jamaica a-wait. Di road long but di journey sweet!
road.enter: Now pon {road} — eyes on di road!
road.enter.Norman Manley Highway / Palis: Palisadoes! Sea on every side — beautiful Jamaica!
Airport road smooth like butter — enjoy it while it last, brethren!
Calm harbour one side, rough open sea di other — yuh entre Jamaica proper!
road.enter.Sir Florizel Glaspole Bouleva: Kingston a-come, driver! Harbour View junction ahead!
Leavin' di Palisadoes — real Kingston life a-start now!
road.enter.Windward Road: Windward Road — welcome to Kingston, capital of Jamaica!
Kingston! Di hustle and bustle — all inna one road!
road.enter.Mountain View Avenue: Mountain View Avenue — National Stadium right deh so!
Big up Excelsior High — Puma dem run and win from right here!
road.enter.Hope Road: Hope Road! Bob Marley Museum jus' up di road — one love!
Hope Road — where Kingston elegance meet Jamaican soul!
road.enter.Hagley Park Road: Half Way Tree coming up! Everybody meet at Half Way Tree!
Hagley Park — nuff taxis, nuff people, nuff life!
road.enter.Spanish Town Road: Spanish Town Road — heading west, leavin' Kingston behind!
Out of di city now — Spanish Town Road tek yuh through!
road.enter.Nelson Mandela Highway: Nelson Mandela Highway — smooth sailing to Bog Walk!
Bypass road — di real Jamaica start when dis highway done!
road.enter.Bog Walk Gorge: Bog Walk Gorge! Rio Cobre runnin' down below — majestic!
Watch di limestone cliffs! Gorge nah business wid careless driving!
Flat Bridge ahead — one lane, nuh railings, pure vibes!
road.enter.Bogwalk Gorge Road: Still inside di gorge — Rio Cobre right there beside yuh!
Walls close, road narrow — tek it easy through di gorge!
road.enter.River Road: River Road — Rio Cobre right beside yuh, fresh and green!
Rio Cobre water flowing strong — Jamaica heartland inna full view!
road.enter.Linstead - Moneague Road: Linstead-Moneague stretch — country road, goat might cross any moment!
Hill country now — easy on di corners, brethren!
road.enter.Milford Road: Fern Gully! Di most beautiful road in di Caribbean!
Milford Road — every Jamaican know it as Fern Gully. Drive slow, soak it in!
Green like emerald, cool like A/C — Fern Gully a Jamaica gift!
Dem fern dem growing since before yuh born — show some respect!
road.enter.Northern Coastal Highway: Northern Coastal Highway — Ocho Rios almost reach! Sea breeze fresh!
Ochi just ahead — Dunn's River Falls a-wait!
Final stretch! Airport to Ochi — you almost done it, brethren!
landmark.enter.Gun Boat Beach: Gun Boat Beach! Coconut tree, calm water — Jamaican paradise right there!
Gunboat Beach — soldier used to anchor here. Now is just pure beach vibes!
landmark.enter.National Stadium: National Stadium! Where Jamaica glory come alive — track, football, everything!
Usain Bolt train near here — di stadium dat build champions!
landmark.enter.Devon House: Devon House! Best ice cream in Jamaica right here — stop if yuh can!
George Stiebel build dat mansion — first black millionaire in Jamaica. Respect!
Devon House ice cream — di only ting sweeter than di journey itself!
landmark.enter.Half Way Tree Clock Tower: Half Way Tree Clock Tower! 1813 — older than Jamaica independence!
Half Way Tree! Every Jamaican pass through here — di crossroads of Kingston!
landmark.enter.Flat Bridge: Flat Bridge! One lane, nuh railing — one of di most thrilling bridges in Jamaica!
Rio Cobre running wild below Flat Bridge — hold di wheel tight!
Historic Flat Bridge — flood come, flood go, but di bridge remain. Respect!
landmark.enter.Faith's Pen: Faith's Pen! Pull over if yuh smart — best jerk chicken on di island!
Faith's Pen cookshop — roast yam, festival, jerk pork! Di road heal everything!
Every driver stop at Faith's Pen — it's tradition, brethren! Nuh bypass it!
landmark.enter.Dunn's River Falls: Dunn's River Falls! Journey done — now is time to cool off!
Airport to Ochi — yuh make it, driver! Jump in di water, yuh earn it!
Di falls a-run, di sea a-shine — Ocho Rios welcome yuh! One love!
pothole.burst: Lawd have mercy — di pothole ketch yuh!
KABOOM! Government nuh fix dem road yet!
Tyre gone flat — dem pothole merciless, man!
Cho! Every day di same road — every day di same pothole!
tyre.fixed: Good as new! Di road a-call yuh back!
Sorted! Press on, driver — Ochi nah reach itself!
cow.block: Man, cow inna di road! Swerve nuh!
Yow! Big cow blocking di way — ease off!
Aye! Di cow herder man nuh care 'bout traffic!
Lawd, cow pon di road again. Dis is Jamaica, driver.
cow.swerve: Nice move! Yuh miss di cow clean!
Irie — cow safe, car safe. Gwaan drive!
Smooth! Dat's how yuh handle Jamaican roads!
dog.bark: Hear how di dog a bark!
Dem dog deh nuh like yuh car, seen?
Every town have dem yard dog. Drive on.
dog.chase: YOW! Dutty dog a follow yuh!
Dog a bark, dog a run — just drive!
Woiee! Di dog dem angry today!
Bwoy, dat dog mean business — skeet!
faithsPen.arrive: Faith's Pen! Pull over and nyam some jerk chicken!
Yow — Faith's Pen cookshop dem right deh so! Stop nuh?
Smell dat jerk? Di best inna Jamaica — pull over, driver!
Faith's Pen! Jerk chicken, roast yam, festival — yuh must stop!
faithsPen.eat: Mmm! Dat jerk chicken fix everyting!
Ah di best food inna Jamaica, dat deh!
Roast yam an' festival — yuh ready fi di road again!
Belly full, tyre good, road ahead — GWAAN!
faithsPen.skip: Yuh pass Faith's Pen?! Lawd, driver...
Bwoy, yuh muss be in a real rush. Next time, stop nuh!
Skipping di jerk? Yuh missing out, brethren.
finish.arrive: YOW! Yuh reach Dunn's River Falls! Jump inna di water, driver!
AIRPORT TO OCHI! Yuh done it, brethren! BIG UP YUHSELF!
Dunn's River! Take off yuh shoes — di bath time now!
Woooooi! End of di road! Dunn's River! JAMAICA!
goat.hit: YUH LICK DOWN DI GOAT?! Bwoy...
Rhatid! Yuh lick di goat, driver!
Woi! Dat poor goat neva deserve dat!
Di goat nevah do yuh nutten an' yuh lick it down!
goat.nearMiss: Nearly lick di billy goat deh!
Aye aye aye — close one! Di goat safe!
Yuh see how yuh nearly mash up di goat?
One love, likkle goat. Drive careful nuh!
landmark.bogWalk: Bog Walk gorge! Look how di river run through!
Rio Cobre down below — Flat Bridge right round di corner!
Bog Walk! Di gorge dem beautiful, seen? Mind di road though!
landmark.dunnsRiver: Dunn's River Falls! YOW! Yuh reach Ocho Rios, driver!
Di falls! Di falls! Jump inna di water!
landmark.fernGully: Fern Gully! Green and cool — one of a kind!
Bamboo and fern all around yuh — dis is Fern Gully, brethren!
Natural air conditioning in Fern Gully! Irie!
landmark.halfWayTree: Half Way Tree! Big junction dis — everybody pass through!
Half Way Tree clock tower! Mi used to lime right deh so!
Half Way Tree — di heart a St. Andrew!
monster.crush: Flatten dem out! Dem can shake dem fist!
Kingston traffic? Nuh problem fi BIG TRUCK!
monster.revert: Back to di Corolla. Gwaan drive.
Monster time done — Corolla again. Easy nuh.
Back to basics, driver. Corolla never let yuh down.
monster.transform: BIG TRUCK TING! Mash dem up!
Traffic too much? TRANSFORM! Clear di road!
YOW! Biggest ting pon di road right now!
offroad.recover: Back pon di road! Thank God!
Yuh make it back! Di Corolla tough, seen?
offroad.slide: WHEEEL! Yuh gone off di road inna di bush!
Dirt road turn into NO road! Come back!
Mountainside nuh have no road, driver — TURN BACK!
road.palisadoes: Palisadoes road — sea pon both side! Beautiful!
Look di harbour! Look di open sea! Jamaica nice!
Airport road straight straight. Sea all around yuh!
score.high: Top driver! Yuh handle Jamaica roads like a PRO!
Respect, driver! Yuh skill is REAL!
Bwoy, yuh drive like yuh born inna Jamaica! Outstanding!
score.mid: Not bad, driver! Few rough spots but yuh made it.
Good drive! Jamaica roads nuh easy but yuh manage.
Solid run, brethren. Practice make perfect!
score.low: Driver... di goats, di potholes, di road... yuh must try harder!
Bwoy. Di road win dis time. Come back and try again!
Plenty damage pon di journey. Next time, tek it easy nuh!
speeding: Yuh a fly, driver! Mind di speed trap!
Easy nuh — di police dem love dis road!
Fast fast fast! Di Corolla a show off!
Bwoy, yuh a drive like yuh late fi work!
traffic.stuck: Kingston traffic! Nuh rush, jus' cool.
Half Way Tree traffic — dis is di life, driver.
Everybody stuck. Welcome to Kingston, brethren.
Yuh nuh go nowhere fast inna Kingston. Patience.
offroad.enter: Aye, weh yuh a go? Di road deh so!
Boss, yuh miss di road! Turn back nuh!
Eh eh, dat nuh look like nuh road to me!
offroad.rough: Dis road rough bad, boss! Turn back before yuh damage di car!
Rhatid! Dem nuh pave dis part at all! Turn around!
Yuh sure yuh know weh yuh a go? Road almost done out here!
offroad.no-road: Jah know! Yuh gone pon di mountainside, brethren! No road nuh deh!
Lawd have mercy — tyre bus'! Dis nuh road, a di mountain slope!
Rhatid! Road done! Yuh a drive off di side a Mount Rosser!
offroad.escape: Tank God yuh find di road back! Almost lick up di place!
Wooii! Yuh make it! Neva do dat again, boss — dat coulda end bad.
See it deh — di real road! Gwaan pon di proper way now.
cowherder.approach: Lawd have mercy — cows dem block di road!
Slow down nuh! Man a walk 'im cows!
Watch out, brethren — cows pon di road!
cowherder.hit: Bwoy, yuh lick di man cow! Him gwaan vex!
Wha di rhatid! Dat a somebody livelihood!
Yuh mash up di farmer cow — dat nuh right, star!
faithspen.approach: Yow! Dat a Faith's Pen! Slow down nuh, bredren!
Jerk chicken and festival up ahead — don't drive past dat!
Faith's Pen dis! Mi belly start talk already...
faithspen.eat: Ahh! Best jerk chicken inna Jamaica — now yuh ready fi drive!
Bless up! Faith's Pen nuh disappoint. Gwaan drive, bredren!
Roast yam, festival, jerk chicken — yuh good fi reach Ochi now!
score.style: Look pon di moves — bredren know di road!
score.halfway: Halfway to Ochi already! Yuh a di real ting!
Pass di halfway mark — keep di wheels dem turning, star!
score.finish: Dunn's River Falls! Yuh reach, champion! Time fi cool off!
Mi cyaan believe seh yuh actually mek it — legend ting!
traffic.kingston: Ah so it set inna di city — everybody a rush!
traffic.near_miss: Yuh nearly bus' him up, bredren!
Lawd have mercy — watch where yuh deh go!
Dem drive like dem mad, sah!
monster.ready: Frustration MAX! Press H fi di big truck ting!
Yuh cyaan tek it no more — press H, transform!
tyre.repaired: Tyre fix up! One love, boss.
Good as new, brethren! Gwaan drive!
Dem patch it quick-quick — back pon di road!
Tyre sort out. Nuh stop, nuh stop!
player.join: Big up {nickname} — anodda driver inna di building!
{nickname} link up — nuh race dem, just drive!
upgrade.exhaust: She puffing now! Exhaust mod done proper, boss!
Backfire and smoke — pure deportee style, yaad man!
upgrade.rims: Look pon di rims! Chrome up and everything!
Gold rims ting! Pure showmanship, bredda!
upgrade.engine: Engine work done — she ready fi road now!
Hood scoop and tune-up — she pulling strong!
upgrade.sound: Big sound system! Earthquake a come, dem a hear you from Ochi!
Bass line drop! Trunk rattling, whole street shaking!
